item.title: Guide: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Walkthrough (Switch 2 Remake): Guide To The Main Quest, Side Quests & Collectables

description.p: Your companion to a huge adventure.Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a dense adventure with many secrets to find, and while the critical path is fairly linear, it's rarely straightforward - asking you to pick up select items and upgrades before you can start exploring its many dungeons.That's why a Zelda: Ocarina of Time walkthrough comes in handy. Though the Switch 2 version follows the same beats as the N64 original, we'd estimate around 10% of the game's puzzles and locations have been changed or updated - just enough to throw off those very familiar with the 1998 version.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

description.p: Physical is dead, eh?After Nintendo's reveal this week that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time had shifted 5.2 million units in its first four days, it will come as no surprise to hear that it's a smash hit in Japan. But still, Famitsu's latest numbers are in, and the physical is flying!According to this week's chart, Link's latest produced ~537,000 physical sales in its chart debut — giving it the lion's share of Japan's 810,000 sales that Nintendo reported, and leaving around 273,000 sales for digital.
